callouts.id: 通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛2#2
callouts.title: 想法1.1
callouts.body:
根据[[通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛性]]当中的经验，我们现在要：
1. 参考[[通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛性#^57d4f2]],我们需要把$A_{\varepsilon}^c$上的情况变成形如$\sum_n \frac{e^{-nx_n}}{n}$形式的级数。然后我们需要进行dyadic分解，并按照$x_n$的值的分布进行划分，得到类似于$$\sum_{n\in B_k}\frac{e^{-nx_n}}{n}\leq \frac{1}{2^k}\sum_{j\geq 0} e^{-j}\#\left\{n\in B_k:x_n<\frac{j+1}{2^k}\right\}$$的结果。其中$B_k=[2^k,2^{k+1})$。
2. 然后我们剩下的步骤便是估计$\#\left\{n\in B_k:x_n<\frac{j+1}{2^k}\right\}$。令$$E(I;\rho):=\left\{n\in I:\delta_n\leq \rho\right\},\quad \rho<1$$实际上我们要估计的是$\#E(I;\rho)$。而这个估计主要是依靠[[通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛性#^8f9f99]]，然后结合$\pi$的无理测度得到。其中关键是要得到$\delta_n$的一个下界估计，从而导出任意$n,m \in E(I;\rho)$的误差$|n-m|$的一个下界。

classification_result.id: 通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛2#2

if_strategy_template.strategy_name_en: Convert to an exponential series and estimate by dyadic decomposition
if_strategy_template.summary_en: Rewrite the contribution on the complementary set into a series of the form $$\sum_n \frac{e^{-n x_n}}{n}$$, then perform a dyadic decomposition by blocks $$B_k=[2^k,2^{k+1})$$ and further group terms according to the size of $$x_n$$. The remaining task is to bound counting functions such as $$\#E(I;\rho)$$ using lower bounds on approximation errors derived from the irrationality measure of $$\pi$$.
if_strategy_template.applicability: Applies when proving convergence of oscillatory or arithmetic series whose terms can be converted into exponential decay, and when the main difficulty reduces to estimating how often certain small-error events occur.
